title: Useful Carts
description: Horse-drawn and hand-pulled carts for travel, shipping, and farming. An unofficial Minecraft 26.2 port of jmb05's NiftyCarts (itself a port of AstikorCarts by MennoMax). MIT, original copyright retained.
body:
## About

**UsefulCarts** adds a whole family of carts — hauled by you on foot or drawn by a horse, donkey, or mule — for getting around, moving your goods, and working your fields.

> ⚠️ **This is an unofficial port.** UsefulCarts is a version port of **NiftyCarts** (by jmb05, itself a Fabric port of **AstikorCarts** by MennoMax) to Minecraft **26.2** and **26.1.2**. I did not create the mod — all of the original code and art belong to their authors; I've only updated it to run on the newest Minecraft. If you play on a version the original supports, please use it instead: **[NiftyCarts on Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/niftycarts)** · **[GitHub](https://github.com/jmb05/nifty-carts)**. Licensed **MIT**.

![Header](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/578d2060752978ff81f61f4adb9d84b7aa6c9a1a.jpeg)


## The carts

- **Supply Cart** — a rolling double-chest you can pull on foot; it also seats a passenger and shows some of its cargo stacked on top.
- **Hand Cart** — a lighter, player-pulled cart with 27 slots of storage.
- **Wagon** — a large horse-drawn hauler with expandable storage (feed it chests), an optional wool-carpet roof, and banner decoration.
- **Animal Cart** — a two-seat cart for ferrying players or livestock; small animals that wander into it climb aboard on their own.
- **Plow** — load it with a hoe, shovel, or axe, then drive it across the ground to till farmland, carve dirt paths, or strip logs.
- **Seed Drill** — holds 9 stacks of seeds and plants them automatically as you pull it over farmland.
- **Reaper** — sit on it while a horse pulls it to mow a wide swath of crops and clear ground growth.

## How to use

Every cart hitches the same way: get within a couple of blocks of it and press the **Attach/Detach Cart** key (**R** by default). On foot you pull it yourself; from the saddle of a horse/donkey/mule your mount pulls it. Press the key again to unhitch. There's also a **Toggle Slow** key (**Z**) for careful maneuvering. Place a cart by right-clicking the ground with the cart item, and right-click storage carts to open them.

## Requirements

- **Fabric Loader** + **[Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)**
- **[Forge Config API Port](https://modrinth.com/mod/forge-config-api-port)** (by Fuzs)
- *Sodium is supported but optional.*

## Credits & license

The original mod, **NiftyCarts**, was made by **jmb05** as a Fabric port of **AstikorCarts** (by **MennoMax** / issork). UsefulCarts only ports that mod to Minecraft 26.x — full credit for the mod goes to them.
